title: Florida Gubernatorial Fellows Program
sponsor: Executive Office of the Governor of Florida
pay_text: At least $18 per hour, plus a $1,000 to $2,000 stipend depending on relocation needs
who_text: Full-time college juniors and seniors, graduate students, and students who just graduated, from schools in Florida
description: Fellows live in Tallahassee for the school year and work in key parts of Florida's state government. You earn an hourly wage while learning how state agencies make and carry out policy.
